title: Resetting Password
content: To reset your password, go to the login page and click on 'Forgot Password'.

title: Account Locked
content: If your account is locked, it may be due to multiple failed login attempts.

title: Subscription Plans
content: Our subscription plans include monthly, quarterly, and annual options.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase under specific conditions.

title: Changing Email
content: To change your email, go to settings and update your contact information.

title: Two-Factor Authentication
content: Enable 2FA from your account security settings to add an extra layer of protection.

title: App Installation
content: You can install our app from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store.

title: App Crashing Issue
content: If your app crashes, try clearing the cache or reinstalling the app.

title: Delete Account
content: To delete your account, navigate to 'Account Settings' and choose 'Delete'.

title: Update Profile
content: You can update your profile picture, bio, and other details from the profile section.

title: Invoice Request
content: To request an invoice, contact billing support with your payment ID.

title: Change Language
content: You can change the app language from the settings under 'Language Preferences'.

title: App Permissions
content: Our app requires permissions for location, camera, and storage to function properly.

title: Reactivating Account
content: You can reactivate your account by logging in and confirming reactivation.

title: Contact Support
content: Reach our support team via the 'Help' section in the app or website.

title: Manage Notifications
content: Manage push and email notifications from 'Notification Settings' in your account.

title: Unsubscribe from Emails
content: To unsubscribe from emails, click on the unsubscribe link at the bottom of the email.

title: Mobile vs Web Features
content: Some features are exclusive to mobile or web versions due to platform capabilities.

title: Data Privacy
content: We value your data privacy and comply with GDPR regulations.

title: Security Tips
content: Follow our security tips to keep your account safe from phishing and fraud.
